en.headline: Driver arrested after van hits elderly woman at Ngau Tau Kok junction
en.dek: Police said an 82-year-old woman was knocked down by a van at the Tung Ming Street and Ngau Tau Kok Road junction around noon and taken unconscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: Police said a van struck an 82-year-old woman surnamed Ling at the junction of Tung Ming Street and Ngau Tau Kok Road in Kwun Tong shortly after noon on Saturday.

The woman suffered a head injury and was found lying on the ground. She was taken unconscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment. Officers later arrested the 40-year-old van driver surnamed Lam on suspicion of dangerous driving. He remains in custody for investigation.
The case is being handled by Kwun Tong police. The cause of the collision is under investigation.

zh.headline: 牛頭角客貨車撞倒八旬婦 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六中午約12時，一輛客貨車在通明街與牛頭角道交界撞倒82歲凌姓老婦，傷者昏迷送伊利沙伯醫院，40歲司機涉危險駕駛被捕。
body: 警方表示，周六中午約12時，一輛客貨車沿觀塘通明街駛至牛頭角道交界時，撞到一名正在過路的82歲姓凌老婦。
老婦後腦受傷流血倒臥地上，昏迷被送往伊利沙伯醫院搶救。警方調查後，以涉嫌危險駕駛拘捕40歲姓林的客貨車司機，他現正被扣留調查。
案件由觀塘警區跟進，意外原因仍有待調查。
